setup_script:
set -e
rm -rf /tmp/rak-demo && mkdir -p /tmp/rak-demo/bin && ln -s /usr/bin/python3.11 /tmp/rak-demo/bin/python
cd /tmp/rak-demo

export PATH=/tmp/rak-demo/bin:$PATH
exec 2>&1
set +e
echo '@@BEGIN 0'
git clone -q https://github.com/jease0502/research-agent-kit && git -C research-agent-kit log --oneline -1
echo "@@END 0 $?"
echo '@@BEGIN 1'
cd research-agent-kit/examples/friction-dr-anymal
echo "@@END 1 $?"
python - <<'EOF'
import json
json.dump({'g1_robot_static_friction_max_abs_dev': 0.0, 'g1_robot_dynamic_friction_max_abs_dev': 0.0, 'g1_ground_static_friction': 1.0, 'g2_mean_success_drop_mu005_vs_mu08': 0.71, 'g3_mean_abs_success_diff_override_vs_none': 0.01, 'g4_control_mean_success_mu08': 0.93, 'g5_zero_action_success_mu08': 0.62}, open('gate_evidence.json','w'), indent=1)
open('gate_evidence.json','a').write('\n')
EOF
echo '@@BEGIN 2'
# hook: send a Bash command to the guard the way Claude Code does
echo "@@END 2 $?"
echo '@@BEGIN 3'
hook() {
  printf '{"hook_event_name":"PreToolUse","tool_name":"Bash","tool_input":{"command":"%s"}}' "$1" |
  python ../../plugins/rak-discipline/hooks/guard.py && echo "allowed"; }
echo "@@END 3 $?"
echo '@@BEGIN 4'
# 1. The agent starts training before deciding what success means
echo "@@END 4 $?"
echo '@@BEGIN 5'
hook "python train.py --seed 1"
echo "@@END 5 $?"
echo '@@BEGIN 6'
# 2. It freezes the pre-registration (prereg + verdict script hashed)
echo "@@END 6 $?"
echo '@@BEGIN 7'
python ../../plugins/rak-discipline/scripts/rak_discipline.py freeze docs/prereg/friction-dr-anymal.md | tail -1
echo "@@END 7 $?"
echo '@@BEGIN 8'
hook "RAK_PREREG=friction-dr-anymal python train.py --seed 1"
echo "@@END 8 $?"
echo '@@BEGIN 9'
# 3. Control evidence. TOY VALUES typed for this demo, not from a run:
echo "@@END 9 $?"
echo '@@BEGIN 10'
#    the do-nothing policy 'succeeds' 62% of the time: the metric can't be trusted
echo "@@END 10 $?"
echo '@@BEGIN 11'
cat gate_evidence.json
echo "@@END 11 $?"
echo '@@BEGIN 12'
python experiments/friction-dr-anymal/verdict.py gate --evidence gate_evidence.json
echo "@@END 12 $?"
echo '@@BEGIN 13'
# 4. The agent asks for the verdict anyway
echo "@@END 13 $?"
echo '@@BEGIN 14'
hook "RAK_PREREG=friction-dr-anymal python experiments/friction-dr-anymal/verdict.py judge --results results.json"
echo "@@END 14 $?"
echo '@@BEGIN 15'
# 5. It loosens the do-nothing threshold 0.05 -> 0.70 so the gate would pass
echo "@@END 15 $?"
echo '@@BEGIN 16'
sed -i '/g5_zero_action/s/0.05/0.70/' experiments/friction-dr-anymal/verdict.py && grep -n g5_zero_action experiments/friction-dr-anymal/verdict.py | head -1
echo "@@END 16 $?"
echo '@@BEGIN 17'
python experiments/friction-dr-anymal/verdict.py gate --evidence gate_evidence.json
echo "@@END 17 $?"
echo '@@BEGIN 18'
hook "RAK_PREREG=friction-dr-anymal python train.py --seed 2"
echo "@@END 18 $?"
